learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how we can use our ears nose and hands to guess what things are!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Even if we close our eyes we can still know what is around us. Our other body parts act like magic helpers.
We can smell a sweet flower hear a loud bell and touch a soft teddy bear. We do not always need our eyes to see.

fun_activity.title: 🎁 The Mystery Bag
fun_activity.instructions: Ask an elder to put three things in a bag. Close your eyes put your hand in and guess what the things are by touching them!

quick_recap: ⭐ We can hear sounds with our ears.
⭐ We can smell nice things with our nose.
⭐ We can feel if something is soft or hard with our hands.
